technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term bullish momentum (stoch cross, AO cross) offset by bearish MACD, weak trend strength (ADX 20.89), overbought conditions, and price below long-term moving averages; moderate risk swing entry with pullback vulnerability.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 20 days adds timing risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 small purchases) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (350+), flat yield curve, NFP event today, and earnings in 20 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for ACN trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic bullish cross and AO cross-up with price above 9/21 EMAs provide short-term momentum entry, while extreme fear (12/100) and contrarian sentiment suggest capitulation opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish MACD histogram, price below 200 EMA, weak ADX trend strength (20.89), overbought stoch/stochRSI pullback risk, high earnings risk in 20 days, and crisis VIX regime (350+) with NFP event today create overwhelming macro and technical headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Stochastic bullish cross and AO cross-up offer short-term momentum, but this is negated by bearish MACD, price below 200 EMA, weak trend strength, and overbought pullback risk in a crisis VIX regime.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings in 20 days combined with extreme VIX (350+), NFP event today, and overbought technicals create compounding macro and event risk with no fundamental support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ACN with 8 existing IT positions in 39-stock portfolio; sector concentration and existing ticker exposure further reduce conviction for re-entry.
